mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_houses (name, status, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{name}, #{status}, #{layoutRows}, #{layoutCols}, #{layoutLayers}, #{requestId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, name, status, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from rabbit_houses where id = #{houseId} for update

select h.id, h.name, h.status, h.layout_rows, h.layout_cols, h.layout_layers, h.remark, h.request_id, h.is_deleted, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time from rabbit_houses h join house_users hu on hu.house_id = h.id and hu.user_id = #{userId} and hu.status = 'ENABLED' where h.is_deleted = false and h.status = 'ENABLED' order by h.id desc

select id, name, status, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from rabbit_houses where is_deleted = false and status = 'ENABLED' order by id asc

select id, name, status, layout_rows, layout_cols, layout_layers, request_id, remark, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from rabbit_houses where create_by = #{createBy} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update rabbit_houses set name = #{name}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
update rabbit_houses set is_deleted = true, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
update rabbit_houses set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{houseId} and is_deleted = false
